item: The elections floor with the operator's Wikidata snapshot run rides the Diagnostics zip and the Field data button again, and a script reads it back
refs: PR #2229; docket row 266; 0.6 gate row A; row 258; R119; R734; R736
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py; src/api/diagnostics_plan.py; src/monitoring/kpi.py; src/static/app-diagnostics.js; scripts/elections_readback.py; tests/test_elections_readback_row266.py
summary: R119 had exempted /elections-floor because its answer was the same on every instance; the snapshot layered in since row 258 is the operator's own run. The member is held to 200,000 bytes (entry lists, then per-country rows, cut and named; still_over with the written size if even that does not fit; the cut block measured with the member). The Field data button saves the same answer; scripts/elections_readback.py reads the file, the zip member or a piece set and prints every absent figure with its reason. K13 reads the snapshot's age and staleness from with_snapshot. Opus read: 7 findings fixed, among them a member 350 bytes over its bound (red before).
